results.note: an HTTP/2 request expecting 100-continue whose HEADERS frame leaves the stream open is sent an interim 100 (HttpObjectAggregator.newContinueResponse on the stream's pipeline)
then its body is read and the request answered; the Expect header is gone from what is recorded
a request expecting 100-continue that ends with its HEADERS frame
trailers over maxHeaderSize after the interim 100 reset the stream on a direct connection
in a SOCKS5 tunnel, trailers over maxHeaderSize after the interim 100 are answered 431 (a 1xx is no response head), then reset
